**Working from home policy change (Operations Division, effective 3 November 2026)**

- **Office days:** Staff must be in the office at least three days a week, up from two. Each team will have a common day.
- **Exceptions:** Staff with a formal flexible work arrangement under Fair Work are unaffected until their review date. Informal manager agreements don't count.
- **Excluded:** Claims Lodgement and Customer Contact teams, whose rosters will be reviewed in early 2027.
- **Equipment:** No new home office equipment funding, except where a workplace health assessment recommends it.
- **Hot desking:** Levels 3 and 4 move to booked desks via the Spaces app, up to two weeks ahead.

**Why:** Survey feedback showed newer staff missed learning from experienced colleagues, and the company wants better use of its office space.
